theme: 教材字彙・進階 650–750 第 39 群

items.pos: adj. 忙碌的；繁忙的
items.colloc: busy season 旺季 | keep busy 保持忙碌
items.distinct: occupied 佔用的 | crowded 擁擠的
ex: Our department is busy during the peak season.
我們部門在旺季時非常忙碌。
She is too busy to attend the meeting.
她太忙了無法參加會議。
The staff stays busy with many new projects.
員工忙於處理許多新專案。

items.pos: v. 投射；投擲 | n. 演員陣容
items.colloc: cast a vote 投票 | cast doubt on 對...表示懷疑
items.distinct: throw 丟擲 | mold 鑄造
ex: Please cast your vote for the new director.
請為新任主管投下你的一票。
The new policy cast doubt on our progress.
新政策使我們對進度產生了懷疑。
The entire cast performed well at the event.
整個演員陣容在活動中表現優異。

items.pos: n. 特色；特徵 | adj. 特有的
items.colloc: distinctive characteristic 獨特特徵 | share a characteristic 擁有共同特點
items.distinct: feature 特點 | quality 品質
ex: Punctuality is a key characteristic of our firm.
準時是我們公司的關鍵特徵。
This is a characteristic trait of successful leaders.
這是成功領導者特有的特質。
They share the same characteristic approach to work.
他們對工作採取相同的特有方法。

items.pos: n. 客戶；委託人
items.colloc: potential client 潛在客戶 | satisfy a client 滿足客戶
items.distinct: customer 消費者 | patron 老主顧
ex: Our team is meeting with a new client today.
我們的團隊今天與一位新客戶會面。
Providing value is important for client retention.
提供價值對留住客戶很重要。
The client requested a change in the design.
客戶要求修改設計內容。

items.pos: v. 攀登；上升 | n. 攀升
items.colloc: climb the ladder 升遷 | steady climb 穩定成長
items.distinct: ascend 上升 | rise 增加
ex: Sales figures continue to climb this quarter.
本季銷售數據持續攀升。
He wants to climb the corporate ladder quickly.
他希望能快速在公司升遷。
Market shares saw a climb after the launch.
產品發布後市佔率有所提升。

items.pos: v. 抱怨；投訴
items.colloc: complain about 抱怨關於 | file a complaint 提出申訴
items.distinct: grumble 碎念 | protest 抗議
ex: Customers often complain about the slow service.
客戶經常抱怨服務速度緩慢。
We received a formal letter to complain today.
我們今天收到一封正式的投訴信。
Nobody wants to complain to the supervisor directly.
沒人想直接向主管抱怨。

items.pos: n. 音樂會；一致
items.colloc: attend a concert 參加音樂會 | in concert 協調一致地
items.distinct: recital 獨奏會 | performance 表演
ex: Our company is sponsoring the upcoming concert.
我們公司正在贊助即將到來的音樂會。
The departments worked in concert to finish tasks.
各部門協調一致地完成了任務。
Tickets for the charity concert sold out fast.
慈善音樂會的門票很快就賣光了。

items.pos: n. 工藝；手藝 | v. 精心製作
items.colloc: craft a strategy 制定策略 | master the craft 精通手藝
items.distinct: skill 技巧 | trade 行業
ex: The team needs to craft a better marketing plan.
團隊需要精心制定一份更好的行銷計畫。
She learned the craft of negotiation over years.
她多年來習得了談判的精湛技巧。
We craft our products with great attention to detail.
我們非常注重細節地精心製作產品。

items.pos: n. 農作物 | v. 收割；修剪
items.colloc: bumper crop 豐收 | export crops 外銷農作物
items.distinct: harvest 收穫 | produce 農產品
ex: The poor weather damaged the local rice crop.
惡劣的天氣損壞了當地的稻米作物。
Farmers expect a good crop this coming season.
農民預期下個季節會有好收成。
We need to crop the images for the report.
我們需要將報告中的圖片進行裁切。

items.pos: n. 十年
items.colloc: over the past decade 過去十年來 | for a decade 長達十年
items.distinct: century 一世紀 | generation 一代
ex: The company has grown steadily over the past decade.
過去十年來公司穩定成長。
Technology has changed significantly in one decade.
科技在十年間發生了重大改變。
She has worked in the industry for a decade.
她在這個行業工作了十年。

items.pos: v. 減少 | n. 下降
items.colloc: decrease in 減少 | sharp decrease 急劇下降
items.distinct: reduce 減低 | decline 衰退
ex: We expect a decrease in production costs soon.
我們預期生產成本很快會下降。
The new policy helps decrease unnecessary paperwork.
新政策有助於減少不必要的文書工作。
A sudden decrease in demand affected our revenue.
需求的突然下降影響了我們的營收。

items.pos: v. 否認；拒絕給予
items.colloc: deny access 拒絕存取 | deny a claim 否認索賠
items.distinct: refuse 拒絕 | reject 駁回
ex: The manager did not deny the recent rumors.
經理並沒有否認最近的謠言。
The bank decided to deny the loan application.
銀行決定拒絕這項貸款申請。
Management will deny any unauthorized entry request.
管理層將拒絕任何未經授權的進入請求。

items.pos: n. 設計 | v. 設計；規劃
items.colloc: design a product 設計產品 | original design 原創設計
items.distinct: pattern 模式 | layout 版面
ex: The team is working on a new website design.
團隊正在進行新的網站設計。
We designed this program to improve productivity.
我們設計這個程式是為了提升生產力。
The design phase will take about three weeks.
設計階段大約需要三週的時間。

items.pos: n. 發現；發掘
items.colloc: make a discovery 做出發現 | new discovery 新發現
items.distinct: invention 發明 | exploration 探險
ex: The latest discovery will change our research focus.
最新的發現將改變我們的研究焦點。
We shared the discovery with the entire team.
我們與整個團隊分享了這個發現。
The new discovery leads to more efficient processes.
這個新發現帶來了更有效率的流程。

items.pos: n. 菜餚；盤子
items.colloc: main dish 主菜 | side dish 配菜
items.distinct: plate 盤子 | meal 餐點
ex: This signature dish is very popular among customers.
這道招牌菜在客戶中非常受歡迎。
Please bring the dishes to the conference room.
請把盤子拿到會議室。
They serve a different dish every single day.
他們每天供應不同的菜餚。

items.pos: v. 展示 | n. 陳列；顯示
items.colloc: on display 展示中 | display window 櫥窗
items.distinct: exhibit 展出 | show 呈現
ex: We plan to display the prototypes at the expo.
我們計畫在博覽會上展示原型機。
The store front features a colorful product display.
店面有一個色彩繽紛的產品陳列。
The screen will display the status of orders.
螢幕會顯示訂單的狀態。

items.pos: adj. 空的 | v. 清空
items.colloc: empty office 空辦公室 | empty out 清空
items.distinct: vacant 未佔用的 | blank 空白的
ex: Please leave the storage room completely empty.
請將儲藏室完全清空。
There were many empty seats at the seminar.
研討會上有很多空位。
The staff had to empty the trash bin daily.
員工必須每天清空垃圾桶。

items.pos: v. 逃脫；避開 | n. 逃跑
items.colloc: escape notice 沒被注意到 | escape from 逃離
items.distinct: flee 逃離 | avoid 避免
ex: The mistake did not escape his sharp eyes.
這個錯誤逃不過他敏銳的雙眼。
We need to find ways to escape the competition.
我們需要找到方法以避開競爭。
Security measures prevent unauthorized people from escaping.
安全措施防止未經授權的人逃離。

items.pos: adj. 預期的；預料中的
items.colloc: as expected 如預期 | expected result 預期結果
items.distinct: anticipated 預期的 | predicted 預測的
ex: The shipment arrived later than we expected.
貨物抵達的時間比我們預期的晚。
We achieved the expected results by the deadline.
我們在期限內達成了預期的結果。
The market shows higher growth than expected.
市場顯示出比預期更高的成長。

items.pos: n. 實驗 | v. 進行實驗
items.colloc: conduct an experiment 進行實驗 | scientific experiment 科學實驗
items.distinct: test 測試 | trial 試驗
ex: The research team will conduct an experiment tomorrow.
研究團隊明天將進行一項實驗。
We decided to experiment with a new working style.
我們決定嘗試一種新的工作方式。
The experiment provided data for our new report.
該實驗為我們的新報告提供了數據。
